description: Zastávky veřejné dopravy is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Česká informační agentura životního prostředí. The Public Transport Stops layer captures stops that can be used by a person with a restriction to transport on busy journeys within the CE-Spaces4All project. They are divided into the following categories: Bus stop and railway station. Coverage: Česká informační agentura životního prostředí. The portal shows the English title as "Public transport stops" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Česká informační agentura životního prostředí. Its keywords include Průvodce přístupnosti, Regionální, Spaces4All. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/45249130/006f5397bc56f8f83b65ed5c5a489e4d/distribuce/89e881b4ee9daaf8879cf6b5d65dfaca/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
